gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.8 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Why Is ISRG Investing More Aggressively in R&D Despite Macro Headwinds?
top.summary: Intuitive Surgical is prioritizing R&D investment over near-term profitability to drive long-term growth, focusing on AI/ML, robotics, and expanding into new clinical areas like GI, cardiac, and lung procedures. top.summary: AstraZeneca's stock has fallen 19.5% in six months due to several clinical and pipeline setbacks, including failed studies for Wainua and Ultomiris, and FDA delays for camizestrant. top.title: Can LLY's Merida Deal Boost Its M&A Push to Diversify Beyond GLP-1s?
top.summary: Eli Lilly announced its 10th acquisition of 2026, agreeing to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion to strengthen its immunology pipeline. The company is strategically diversifying its portfolio across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and vaccines to reduce reliance on GLP-1 medicines (Mounjaro and Zepbound), which currently account for 65% of revenues. Other major pharma companies including Merck, Gilead Sciences, and AbbVie are also pursuing significant M&A deals to expand pipelines and enter new therapeutic areas.

top.title: Can Bixlenvo Unlock New Growth for Gilead's HIV Business?
top.summary: Gilead Sciences received FDA approval for Bixlenvo, a once-daily single-tablet HIV regimen for virologically suppressed adults unable to take current treatments. The company raised its 2026 HIV sales growth outlook to 9-10%, driven by flagship drugs Biktarvy, Descovy, and the rapidly growing Yeztugo injectable PrEP. Bixlenvo and Gilead's expanding lenacapavir pipeline offer additional growth opportunities in HIV treatment and prevention.

top.title: Wall Street Analysts See Gilead (GILD) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
top.summary: The article compares brokerage analyst recommendations (ABR) with Zacks Rank, arguing that while Gilead Sciences has a strong Buy-equivalent ABR of 1.52 from 31 firms, brokerage recommendations suffer from positive bias due to institutional conflicts of interest. The Zacks Rank, based on earnings estimate revisions rather than analyst opinions, is presented as a more reliable predictor of near-term stock performance. Gilead received a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating due to a 40.4% increase in consensus earnings estimates over the past month.

top.title: New Measurement Data: AI Engines Disagree by 2× on Which Brands to Recommend, Treyci Analysis Finds

top.title: Does Moderna's mRNA Flu Shot Face a New Challenge From GSK?
top.summary: Moderna secured FDA approval for mFlusiva, the first mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine, establishing a foothold in the multibillion-dollar flu vaccine market. However, GSK announced plans to advance its own mRNA flu vaccine into phase III trials, which targets two viral proteins (HA and NA) and showed superior immune responses in phase II studies. While GSK's vaccine is still years away from market approval, it could pose a competitive challenge to Moderna's mFlusiva, which currently targets only HA like traditional flu vaccines.

top.title: GSK to Advance mRNA Influenza Vaccine Into Phase III Development
top.summary: GSK announced it will begin a Phase III efficacy study of its mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine in September 2026, following positive Phase II results showing higher immune responses than standard and high-dose flu vaccines. The vaccine uniquely targets both HA and NA antigens, unlike most existing flu vaccines. The FDA granted Fast Track designation to the candidate. Moderna's mFlusiva mRNA flu vaccine was recently approved by the FDA for adults 50+.

top.title: Can Bixlenvo Unlock New Growth for Gilead's HIV Business?

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Does Moderna's mRNA Flu Shot Face a New Challenge From GSK?
top.summary: Moderna secured FDA approval for mFlusiva, the first mRNA-based seasonal flu vaccine, establishing a foothold in the multibillion-dollar flu vaccine market. However, GSK announced plans to advance its own mRNA flu vaccine into phase III trials, which targets two viral proteins (HA and NA) and showed superior immune responses in phase II studies. top.title: Shell's Tri Star Deal Deepens Its U.S. Fuel Retail Strategy
top.summary: Shell plc announced it will acquire the remaining 67% stake in Tri Star Energy, gaining full ownership of 320 fuel and convenience retail sites across the Southeastern United States. top.title: California Resources Completes $63M Acquisition of Crimson Midstream
top.summary: California Resources Corporation (CRC) has completed its $63 million acquisition of Crimson Midstream Holdings from CorEnergy Infrastructure Trust. The deal expands CRC's midstream infrastructure in California, providing greater control over oil transportation to higher-value markets and improving operational flexibility. CRC is also evaluating Crimson's pipeline corridors for potential CO2 transportation as part of its carbon management strategy. Near-term financial contribution is expected to be modest, with Q3 2026 G&A and capital expenses estimated at $1-2 million each.

top.title: Can Par Pacific's Stronger Balance Sheet Fuel Its Next Growth Phase?
top.summary: Par Pacific (PARR) has strengthened its balance sheet by reducing net debt by over $220 million in Q2 2026, achieving $1.4 billion in liquidity. With improved financial flexibility, the company is pursuing smaller-scale refining and logistics projects targeting low-20% unlevered returns, along with M&A and share buybacks. Devon Energy and Phillips 66 have similarly strengthened their balance sheets through debt reduction, positioning all three companies for growth investments and improved long-term cash generation.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +5.0 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +5.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The lawsuit alleges that PROCEPT made materially false statements regarding its discount programs, handpiece unit sales, and revenue guidance. The company allegedly used undisclosed bulk order discounts that artificially inflated sales figures and created over 10,000 excess units of field inventory, exposing the company to material operational and financial risks.

top.title: BE DEADLINE: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Bloom Energy Corporation Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BE
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors who purchased securities of Bloom Energy Corporation (BE) between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026 to join a class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Bloom Energy made materially false and misleading statements regarding its reliance on scandium sourced from China through intermediaries, which was not properly disclosed to investors. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 28, 2026. Similar class action notices are being issued for PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (PRCT) and Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. (HTZ).

top.title: HTZ IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HTZ

top.title: WIX FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, A TOP-RANKED LAW FIRM, Encourages Wix.com Ltd. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – WIX

top.summary: Shell plc has completed its acquisition of ARC Resources Ltd., adding approximately 370 kboe/d of production and expanding its Montney basin position by over 1.5 million net acres. The acquisition strengthens Shell's upstream portfolio and complements its LNG Canada operations.

top.title: Shell's Tri Star Deal Deepens Its U.S. Fuel Retail Strategy

The deal, expected to close by end of 2026, aligns with Shell's strategy to focus capital on high-return businesses and will nearly double its company-owned retail footprint in the region to approximately 550 sites.

top.title: HF Sinclair Plans Lubricants Spin-Off: Is it a Value-Unlocking Move?

The separation includes retiring the Mississauga refinery and shifting to a capital-light lubricants model. Meanwhile, energy majors Eni and Shell are simplifying portfolios through asset sales and restructuring to unlock value and improve capital allocation.

This acquisition marks Lilly's 10th major deal in 2026 as the company diversifies its pipeline beyond cardiometabolic medicines, leveraging strong cash generation from its blockbuster GLP-1 drugs.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.9 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -13.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of York Space Systems Investors
top.summary: York Space Systems faces a class action lawsuit covering investors who purchased securities between January 29, 2026 and May 11, 2026. Investors have until October 30, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

top.title: JAZZ Rises on Updated OS Results From Gastric Cancer Study
top.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals announced second interim results from the HERIZON-GEA-01 study showing statistically significant overall survival improvements for Ziihera plus chemotherapy versus standard of care trastuzumab plus chemotherapy in HER2-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma. The three-drug regimen of Ziihera plus Tevimbra and chemotherapy also demonstrated improved OS hazard ratios with longer follow-up. These results support the recent FDA label expansion of Ziihera for first-line treatment in this indication, significantly expanding its commercial opportunity.
